title: Target Execution Simulation
aria: Execution simulation: shoot, slash, or blow up Yugeru. He will always come back.

unlocked.slash: New weapon: SLASH. Drag across his body, hold, or right-click.
unlocked.explode: New weapon: BUILDING DEMOLITION. Press 3 / E, or tap with two fingers.

intro: Click to shoot. Twin pistols, two hands, zero hesitation.
keyboardHint: Keyboard: 1/2/3 choose a weapon, Space to attack.
ready: Give it up. He won't die. Maybe… this isn't a story about killing.
complaints: The collar. You ruined the collar.
Could you aim somewhere without seams?
For the record: this cape is older than your country.
Another hole. My tailor died two hundred years ago.
I have died more creatively than this.
I'm paying for results, not for noise.
Boring. But you came back. That's… interesting.
You don't give up, do you.
Three and a half thousand years, and you're the only one who keeps coming back.
If you come again tomorrow, I'll wear something cheaper.
Strangely, I've started waiting for the hour you arrive.
Don't stop. I mean… carry on with your work.
